recentItems.title: How the world said goodbye to Steve Irwin | 60 Minutes Australia
recentItems.description:
After his untimely death, a shattered nation came to a standstill to mourn Steve Irwin.

At an emotional public memorial, Australians reached out to embrace a grieving family who were forced to say a sudden goodbye to their husband and father.

recentItems.title: How a crocodile sparked Steve Irwin's relationship with Terri | 60 Minutes Australia
recentItems.description:
Terri was an unsuspecting tourist when a crocodile demonstration sparked a wild romance and a dangerous honeymoon at the start of Steve Irwin's global television career.

However, this shared obsession with confronting one of the world's deadliest creatures would eventually pave the way for the legendary conservationist's sudden and tragic death.

Watch Steve Irwin: A Wild Life on the 60 Minutes Australia YouTube channel.

recentItems.title: Steve Irwin's cameraman recounts his final moments | 60 Minutes Australia
recentItems.description:
Today marks 20 years since the world lost the Crocodile Hunter, Steve Irwin.

Justin Lyons filmed Steve Irwin's most iconic encounters for fifteen years, and he always knew that he might one day capture the wildlife icon's death as well.

Irwin was pierced in the chest by a stingray on the Great Barrier Reef, bleeding out in a small boat as he looked his mate in the eye.

Watch Steve Irwin: A Wild Life on the 60 Minutes Australia YouTube channel: https://youtu.be/sRhJtsUH5VI
